parts.text: {"title": "Guide", "sections": [{"heading": "Offline drafts", "text": "A draft comment survives a page reload while offline. Drafts are kept in the browser for seven days. A draft is sent once when the connection returns. A draft older than seven days is dropped with a notice.", "sources": ["doc-drafts"]}, {"heading": "Certificate rotation", "text": "The signing certificate rotates every ninety days. The rotation runs without a restart of the service. An expired certificate is refused at sign-in with a clear message. The platform team is paged when a rotation fails.", "sources": ["doc-certificate"]}], "empty_reason": null, "rationale": "One section per source, in the sources' own words."}
